recipe.visualDefinition: A maximalist, psychedelic collage featuring a central sunburst pattern in yellow and dark brown, overlaid with a dense assembly of hand-drawn surrealist elements including human faces, celestial bodies, animals, and mystical figures in a vibrant, saturated palette.
coreVisualRelationships: Radial sunburst background creates a focal point behind the central figures.
Foreground hands reaching toward the viewer create extreme depth.
Eclectic iconography (dolphins, stars, eyes) creates a dreamlike narrative.
High-contrast black drop shadows on text separate typography from the busy background.
coreInvariants: Yellow and dark brown radial sunburst
Hand-drawn, illustrative style with visible line work
Dense, overlapping composition with no negative space
Saturated primary and secondary color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large central male faces dominate the mid-ground, with a large hand reaching into the extreme foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The center of the sunburst, located behind the main figure's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the central faces outward along the sunburst rays to the smaller peripheral illustrations.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Zero; the entire frame is filled with overlapping graphics and textures.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation across all elements with high-value yellow providing a luminous quality.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high contrast between background rays

letterConstructionRules: Consistent thick black drop shadow to the bottom-right
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'E' are constructed from rectangular segments
Apostrophe is a simple small block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Secondary text uses a lighter, outlined version of the same geometric skeleton.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and blocky presence.
Best matches the specific 90s techno-inspired angles.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a psychedelic collage with a yellow and dark brown sunburst background. Include hand-drawn illustrations of faces, dolphins, stars, and surreal figures in a saturated 90s style. Leave the top third clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, geometric, uppercase white lettering with a thick black drop shadow at the top center. Add a secondary line of outlined geometric text below it.

verificationChecks: Is the sunburst background high contrast?
Are the foreground illustrations hand-drawn in style?
Does the text have a hard, offset black shadow?
Is the composition densely packed with no empty space?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures
Exact placement of minor collage elements
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sunburst rays converge behind the central figure.
Check that the text is legible against the busy background.
Verify the presence of surrealist elements like eyes and celestial bodies.
Confirm the hand-drawn aesthetic is consistent across all collage pieces.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast radial sunburst with a dense layer of hand-drawn surrealist illustrations and top-aligned, blocky geometric display type with hard drop shadows.
